study.title: Reducing motion artifacts in craniocervical background subtraction angiography with deformable registration and unsupervised deep learning

imaging.modality_detail: Craniocervical (cervico-cerebral) digital subtraction angiography series; 12-bit DICOM downsampled from 1024x1024 to 512x512

data_released.detail: IRB does not allow public dissemination; sample data available on request

annotation.annotator_expertise: Board-certified interventional neuroradiologists (2, 4 and 14 years post-fellowship) acting as blinded raters for evaluation
annotation.inter_rater_value: Average deviation of individual Likert score from group consensus 0.13

task.task_description: Unsupervised deep learning deformable registration (HyperMorph-based) of the precontrast background mask to each postcontrast frame, followed by subtraction to produce motion-artifact-reduced background subtraction angiography; novel vessel layer estimate (VLE) image similarity loss.
task.clinical_application: Reducing misregistration/motion artifacts in craniocervical DSA to improve image quality and reduce repeat acquisitions

temporal_evidence.quote: learns the nonrigid morph field for the background frame (moving image) relative to the contrast frame (fixed image)

metrics.metric: Percentage reduction in repeat acquisitions vs DSA (reviewer 1)
Percentage reduction in repeat acquisitions vs DSA (reviewer 2)
Percentage reduction in repeat acquisitions vs DSA (reviewer 3)

G2.quote: we have not established the generalizability of our deep learning model on datasets outside of our home institution

G4.quote: 2D deformable registration cannot fully capture the complex 3-dimensional/2D projective motion present in fluoroscopic images

G5.quote: Because of the absence of ground truth data for quantitative assessment, all hyperparameter tuning must rely on expert review

G6.quote: accurate assessment of the true clinical impact of deep learning BSA will require edge implementation and integration into the procedural workflow

other_limitations: Images evaluated deidentified without clinical context
Biplane/oblique complementary views not considered when judging repeat acquisitions
Formal Likert review performed at only one hyperparameter value (lambda = 0.7)
Misregistration artifacts not completely eliminated under significant motion
future_work: Edge implementation and integration into the procedural workflow
Assess true clinical impact on decision-making
